source: Generated with sdk/src/mcp.js (normalizeTools, toolsDigest) and sdk/src/canon.js (safeParseJSON, canonicalJSON) at https://github.com/BruceLanLan/tapeapi/tree/fda84db889d2a732915f264a799af24073177a85; the first positive case is the vector of sdk/test/mcp-core.test.mjs at that commit.
rule: tools = the JSON text toolsJson parsed with the strict parser; normalized = canonicalJSON(tools reduced to the members name, title, description, inputSchema, outputSchema, annotations that are present (null counts as present), sorted by name in UTF-16 code-unit order); toolsSha256 = lowercase hex SHA-256 of UTF-8(normalized), without 0x.

positive.name: two tools; icons and _meta are not covered
same two tools in the other order, members reordered, no icons or _meta: same digest
text appended to a description: a different digest

positive.name: null counts as present; false, 0 and "" are kept
names sorted by UTF-16 code units (U+1F600 before U+FF5A)

negativeNote: Each text has no toolsSha256: parsing or normalising it fails. A client that reads such a list from mcp.endpoint uses none of the service's tools.

negative.name: two tools with the same name
a tool whose name is empty
a tool whose name is not a string
a tool that is not an object
the list is not an array
a repeated member name inside a tool
a repeated member name written once with an escape
an unpaired surrogate in a description
